topic.title: Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: Review tasks provide a shared review space where task owners and reviewers collect feedback, discuss changes, and track review progress.

body.p: In , review tasks are used to collect feedback on content. A task owner shares content with reviewers, who open the task in a browser-based editor to read, comment, and suggest changes.
Review tasks support a focused review workflow. Instead of sending files by email, authors can share a task link and keep comments, suggestions, and discussions in one place.
supports two types of review tasks: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks, see for specific details about each task type.
Within a review task, users participate through review task roles:

ul.li: Owner - Manages the task, shares access, and controls the review workflow.
Reviewer - Reviews the content, adds comments, suggests changes, and joins discussions.

body.p: Project Review Tasks can be created only by Authors. Independent Review Tasks can be created by both Authors and Subject-Matter Experts. Any user can participate in a review task as a reviewer.
To understand how review tasks progress and how participants work in them, see Review Task States and User Roles. To learn how to access and open tasks see .Review Task Roles
